user.title: Quick Access
user.description: Add the Quick Access launcher to Home Assistant.

init.title: Resource limits
init.description: Limits apply immediately to all Quick Access users; usage is counted per user. Lowering limits preserves existing profiles. Users can still view profiles and reduce usage.

data_description.max_categories: From 1 to 200 groups per profile, including Favorites.
data_description.max_user_mib: From 1 to 16 MiB across all profiles and document metadata. One MiB is 1,048,576 bytes.
data_description.max_profile_mib: From 1 to 4 MiB. Cannot exceed total storage per user.

error.invalid_limit: Enter a whole number within the allowed range.
error.profile_exceeds_user: Maximum storage per profile cannot exceed total storage per user.
